item.title: Planet Barnsley
item.description: Planet Barnsley is the first solo exhibition by Cara Proud, using immersive digital worlds to reimagine the town's identity, technology, and future possibilities. A survivor of the future clambered for spare parts to assemble their own independent computer. Technology in their world is designed to extract as much information, energy, and money as possible. item.title: National Gallery Masterpiece Tour Mignard: Love, Power, Identity
item.description: A beautiful masterpiece from the National Gallery collection will go on display in Barnsley this autumn as the Cooper Gallery presents The National Gallery Masterpiece Tour, Mignard: Love, Power, Identity, a major new exhibition exploring themes of status, self-image and representation through art.

item.title: Goldsmiths North
item.description: This autumn, Goldsmiths North and Wentworth Woodhouse will be collaborating for the first time to hold a unique event in our magnificent House. Specially selected Goldsmiths North exhibitors will be showing and selling their beautiful, handmade silverware and jewellery at Wentworth Woodhouse from Friday 13th to Sunday 15th November – perfect for Christmas shopping.
